text:
Alex: Heads up — planning for an Oct/Nov traffic bump concentrated on the East coast (us-east-2). Need to lock extra GPU capacity for a ~6‑week window. Ballpark ask: 500k GPU-hours. Thoughts on H200 vs a mixed fleet with L40S?

Maria: Do we have a throughput target and workload mix? chat vs embeddings vs reranking?

Alex: Throughput target is ~1200 concurrent tokens/s at peak across the fleet with p95 latency SLO ~60ms for interactive routes. Workload is ~70% chat (longer sequences, ~2k tokens), 20% embeddings, 10% rerank.

Jin: Quick hardware tradeoff notes: H200 = best perf for long seqs but long lead times (12–20w). L40S = faster procurement (4–6w) but you need more instances and more NIC/rack overhead. H100 sits between. Estimated cost/GPU-hour: H200=$6.50, H100=$5.25, L40S=$4.10 (cloud partner list).

Lia: Hybrid looks sensible: reserve a slice of H200 for latency-sensitive routes and use L40S for burst capacity. Need to validate rack power + NICs in us-east-2 — there are recent power caps in partner datacenters.

ProcurementBot: Procurement check — earliest ship dates if PO goes out today: H200 -> 2026-01-12, H100 -> 2025-12-08, L40S -> 2025-11-20. Lead times include partner allocation windows.

Maria: If H200 shipping slips, can we fail over to EU spare racks and route traffic? What is the cross-region egress/cost/latency impact?

Jin: Cross-region failover adds ~40–80ms depending on path. We can route only non-sensitive workloads to EU to avoid compliance issues. Costwise, at the expected volume that's ~+$4k/week in egress and cross-region cloud fees (rough estimate). Also increases SRE ops complexity.

SRE-Oncall: Action: I'll run a 6‑week horizon sim (GPU-hours, SLO violations per fleet mix, cost delta) and include power/network constraints for us-east-2. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Alex: Also call out billing model: we prefer a committed reservation for discount (monthly/annual), but we need a flexible burst plan for unexpected peaks. Procurement — can we do commit + burst?

ProcurementBot: PO template: `PO-EDGE-2025-FALL.pdf`. Finance needs an estimated commit discount delta for approvals.

SRE-Oncall: Quick sim results (summary): H200-only meets SLO and gives ~15% lower infra op cost vs L40S-only but requires ~18 additional racks (power/NIC heavy). Hybrid (30% H200 + 70% L40S burst) meets SLO, reduces lead-time risk, and is bookable within our windows. Hybrid cost premium vs H200-only ≈ +8% but avoids a 12–20w dependency. Full sims + charts: https://go/sim/fall-east (internal).

Maria: Recommendation: proceed with hybrid booking. Target: reserve 150 H200-equivalents (can be split H200/H100 based on final PO) and cover remaining capacity with L40S burst reservations. I'll own finance/PO sync.

Alex: Nice. Lia/Jin — please confirm power and NIC checks for the 18-rack delta by Thursday. OpsBot, flag this to runbook for cross-region failover testing. :thumbsup:

OpsBot: Runbook flagged and failover test ticket created: INFRA-6123.

Alex: Thanks everyone — will loop legal if PO terms require change.
